definitions.success_rate: Accepted predictions with IoU >= threshold / all labeled visible frames; rejected or missing predictions fail.
definitions.precision: Accepted predictions with IoU >= threshold / all accepted labeled frames; false acceptance during absence fails.
definitions.decision_accuracy: (Successful visible predictions + correct rejection on explicitly absent frames) / all labeled frames.
definitions.false_lock: Accepted prediction on an absent frame, or accepted visible prediction with IoU < 0.1.
definitions.coverage: Annotation coverage is labeled/processed; visible tracking coverage is accepted/labeled-visible. Neither is accuracy.
definitions.scope: Initialization is excluded. Missing labels are unmeasured, not absent. Rates describe only evaluated annotations and do not establish 99% accuracy on other videos.

note: Tracking states are not an accuracy score. Timing excludes browser encoding, network, decoding and display.
